title: arenaria arenarioides var. spathulata
intro: Arenaria arenarioides var. spathulata, commonly known as Sea Sandwort, is a plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is native to the coastal regions of Western Europe and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sea Sandwort include wound healing, anti-arthritic, and anti-diabetic activities, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. Furthermore, the plant's bioactive constituents may also possess anti-cancer and immunomodulatory effects, although further research is needed to confirm these properties.
